description:
Runs Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI and other terminal coding agents together on one mission.

Runner is a native desktop application where terminal agents work together. Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor CLI, Grok Build, Antigravity CLI, Copilot CLI and pi can take the same task in one mission, and each agent keeps its own TUI in a real terminal while the lead brings the decisions back to you. Everything in Runner is also a `runner` command: missions, crews, roles, projects, chats, sessions and messages are all addressable from the command line, with `runnerd` as the background service. Agents run natively on Windows without WSL, and PowerShell 7 is optional. Status: alpha, actively shipping. Native builds target macOS (Apple Silicon) and Windows (x64) on Windows 10 version 1809 or later; Intel Macs, Windows ARM64 and Linux are not supported. The installer, the application and the CLI sidecars are Authenticode-signed with a Certum open-source certificate issued to Open Source Developer Yicheng Wang.
Runner 0.18.3 is a feature release for macOS, Windows and Linux on top of 0.18.2.
New
- Choose a project before starting. New chat and New mission now let you choose the project alongside the working directory. The choice follows matching directories, preserves worktree paths and explicit No project selections, and warns when the directory is outside the selected project. Chats added to a pane use their tab's project. (#968)
- A shared goal for every mission member. Crews no longer require a designated lead: every member receives the goal, team conventions and its own brief, and any member can be removed. runner ask "<question>" now asks you directly; --human remains an alias. (#873)
- Status for agents started in a terminal. Compatible programs launched by hand in terminal tabs can now report Working, Idle and Needs you through the Program Status Protocol (OSC 7501), including when their pane is not visible. Existing agent hooks keep precedence. (#861)
- Simplified Chinese user guide. The complete guide is now available in Simplified Chinese, with the same topics and navigation as the English guide. CLI commands and generated help remain in English. (#1058)
Bug fixes
- Codex input waits show Needs you. Runner now recognizes Codex's native approval and question waits instead of leaving the session marked Working, and clears the wait when Codex reports that it has resumed. (#1008)
- Remote sidebar views stay where you left them. Switching computers and returning now restores each remote computer's Show all / Show active only choice and collapsed sections, projects and Active groups, independently in each window. (#1047)
- Unsent inbox notices no longer stall later delivery. If an inbox notice's Return does not take, Runner keeps track of its own text and retries submission without typing a second notice over it. Prolonged delivery holds now produce a mission warning visible in runner mission show. (#1075)
Nightly channel
- A new nightly build for macOS, Windows and both Linux architectures is now triggered automatically after every merged pull request. The shared nightly prerelease and update channels stay the same.
